data.narrative:
Ouster operates in Chips & Semiconductors as a publicly listed company with a current market valuation of $2.26B. The comparable universe consists of 11 peers across the sector—3 public companies and 8 private entities spanning Series A through Pre-IPO stages. The peer set includes both infrastructure-focused competitors (SambaNova Systems at $11.0B, PsiQuantum at $7.0B, Etched at $5.0B) and later-stage private companies closer to Ouster's valuation tier (Tenstorrent at $2.7B, Rebellions at $2.3B).

Peer-median valuation analysis provides the primary triangulation method applicable to this assessment. The median valuation across the 9 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables is $2.3B, with a range spanning $529M at the low end to $11.0B at the high end. This method directly anchors to Ouster's current trading position.

The triangulated valuation range supports $2.0B to $2.7B, centered on $2.3B, which closely aligns with Ouster's current market capitalization. The analysis relies on a single primary method due to data constraints; additional valuation methods (revenue multiples, DCF) would require operational metrics not present in the dataset. Key uncertainties include variance in the peer set's stage distribution and the broad range of comparable valuations, which reflects heterogeneity in business model maturity and market positioning within the semiconductor subsector.
